summary: Verified Mira paint parallelism fix (paint_offloop). All 6 backend tests PASSED in 74s: (1) batch generate-missing-images painted 2 services in ~18s with poll latency <3s (parallelism confirmed), (2) single-service paint job completes with valid /api/files/ URL, (3) generate-all-banners on existing category returns 200 + finishes cleanly, (4) unrelated endpoints (/services, /dashboard/stats, /customers) stay <3s while a batch runs, (5) regression smoke on /services, /service-categories, /services/image-weight all 200, (6) concurrent batch POST correctly returns 409. Frontend Services page loads for salon admin; both 'Mira Photos' (generate-missing-images-btn) and 'Mira Banners' (generate-all-banners-btn) buttons render and are visible; no console errors originating from Services page (only pre-existing 401/429 background pings and an unrelated Dashboard hydration warning in MiraDayOffer).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> child inside <option> in MiraDayOffer.jsx line 55 — instrumentation-injected span breaks HTML validity

critical_code_review_comments: paint_offloop pattern (asyncio.to_thread + asyncio.run wrapping generate_images) is the correct fix for the litellm sync blocking; batch of 2 finished in ~18s (single-image time) confirming true parallelism via Semaphore(8).
GET /api/services/{sid} does not exist (only PUT/DELETE at that path); test had to fetch the list. Minor API-shape suggestion: expose a single-service GET for consistency.
Unrelated: Dashboard MiraDayOffer has invalid HTML (<span> inside <option>) causing hydration warning.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own temp services under a unique 'ZZ QA ...' category and deletes them in finally block. Total real images painted this run: 2 (batch) + 1 (single) + 1 (banner regen on existing category) + 2 (event-loop test) + 2 (409 test partially painted) ≈ ≤8 within budget.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix is validated. test_mira_paint_parallel.py can be reused as regression. Poll latency assertion (<3s) is the key event-loop-not-blocked signal. Note: /api/services returns a list (not wrapped).
